rag_rationale: Tool works and is used, but the benefit case is on hold until customer-facing approval; rollout date at risk.
headline: First drafts in 20 minutes instead of two days, but the €1.4M benefit waits on customer-facing AI approval.
progress: 25 account managers piloting; 63 proposals drafted since August
Template library complete: 12 templates, 140 approved content blocks
Proposals generated directly from CRM opportunity records

risks.title: Benefit blocked by customer-facing approval
risks.description: Every proposal is fully rewritten by humans until the customer-facing checklist is approved, removing most of the time saving.
risks.evidence: we can't claim the €1.4M productivity benefit until it's resolved

risks.title: Wrong product specs from stale index
risks.description: The shared knowledge index depends on the delayed product catalogue; a wrong spec could reach a signed contract.
risks.mitigation: Product spec sections locked to human-written content until the new index is live.
risks.evidence: Accuracy risk on technical specs in proposals

risks.title: Cross-customer pricing leakage
risks.description: Retrieval could surface one customer's pricing in another customer's proposal.
risks.mitigation: Retrieval scoped per account; red-team test in November.
risks.evidence: the model could mix up pricing from one customer's proposal into another

risks.title: Sales training date unconfirmed
risks.description: Training for about 180 sellers cannot be scheduled without a rollout date.
risks.evidence: we can't confirm a date yet

dependencies.what: Shared retrieval service and product knowledge index
Product catalogue feeding the knowledge index

asks: Agree SAL-08 joins CRM-01's customer-facing checklist dry run instead of a separate review
